choicesEn: Natural mineral formations used by humans
choicesUz: Odamlar tomonidan ishlatiladigan tabiiy mineral tuzilmalar
explanationEn: The solid shell of the Earth is called the lithosphere (from the Greek “lithos” - stone, “sphaira” - ball).
explanationUz: Erning qattiq qobig'i litosfera deb ataladi (yunoncha "litos" - tosh, "sphaira" - to'p).
